Energy Generation
As one of the leading energy companies of Türkiye, we have a total
installed power capacity of 881,37 MW in five main energy sources:
geothermal energy, wind energy, solar energy, hydroelectric energy
and natural gas.

With our installed capacity in Türkiye, we provide 100% of our
electricity production from renewable energy sources.

Summary
As Zorlu Enerji, we provide 92% of our installed capacity in Türkiye from
renewable energy sources, which accounts for 70% of our total installed capacity.
By 2030, our goal is to source 100% of our total installed capacity from
renewable resources.
